## Core Focus & Flagship Projects

### 1. Linux Kernel Mainline Contribution
- **Description:** Upstream kernel patch in the STMicroelectronics 10/100/1000 Ethernet driver (`drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac/stmmac_main.c`).
- **Fix:** Fixed OF device node reference count leaks in `stmmac_mtl_setup()` on early loop termination using modern scoped clean-up `for_each_child_of_node_scoped()`.
- **Reviewers:** Reviewed and signed off by Linux networking maintainer Jakub Kicinski (`kuba@kernel.org`), merged into mainline by Linus Torvalds.
- **Commit:** https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/317fe168f4c0fc30e5c375c22d9c8911940aea9b

### 2. AuthLX Platform
- **Description:** Complete authentication, licensing, and access management platform.
- **Components:** High-throughput API backend, Next.js administrative dashboard, Discord bot application serving over 10,000 users, and multi-language client SDKs.
- **Client SDKs:** Published packages on NuGet and PyPI for Python, C++, C#, and Java.
- **Website:** https://authlx.com
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/AuthLX

### 3. WindowCaptureHider
- **Description:** High-performance C++ Windows DLL that masks and excludes top-level application windows from screen capture utilities (OBS Studio, Windows Snipping Tool, streaming software).
- **Core Technology:** Windows API (`SetWindowDisplayAffinity`), C++, low-overhead memory injection.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rabbanyhmm/WindowCaptureHider
- **License:** AGPL-3.0

### 4. DnSpyMCP
- **Description:** Model Context Protocol (MCP) server engineered for .NET reverse engineering, assembly inspection, and IL2CPP dump analysis.
- **Features:** Exposes 31 specialized tools allowing AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to perform deep assembly analysis, cross-referencing, and binary patch generation.
- **Core Technology:** C#, .NET, Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rabbanyhmm/DnSpyMCP
- **License:** MIT

### 5. ClipTrayLT
- **Description:** Lightweight, responsive clipboard history manager built for Linux desktop environments with instant cursor-position popup activation and searchable history.
- **Core Technology:** C++, Linux, X11/Desktop Integration.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rabbanyhmm/ClipTrayLT
- **License:** Open-source

### 6. Extreme-Injector-Open-Source
- **Description:** Open-source Windows dynamic link library (DLL) injector engineered in C# utilizing native Win32 kernel and process memory management APIs (`VirtualAllocEx`, `WriteProcessMemory`, `CreateRemoteThread`).
- **Core Technology:** C#, .NET, Win32 Memory Management.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rabbanyhmm/Extreme-Injector-Open-Source
- **License:** Open-source

### 7. Discord Automation (DiscordServerClonner & ExistNuker)
- **DiscordServerClonner:** Python utility for duplicating server architectures, emojis, stickers, channel hierarchies, and validating auth tokens without elevated administrative rights on source servers (https://github.com/rabbanyhmm/DiscordServerClonner).
- **ExistNuker:** Multi-threaded stress-testing and channel administration tool designed to benchmark Discord API throughput boundaries and rate-limit handling (https://github.com/rabbanyhmm/ExistNuker).
- **Core Technology:** Python, Asynchronous I/O, REST APIs.

### 8. VideoCaptionBurner
- **Description:** Automated FFmpeg-based video subtitle engine providing millisecond timing control, font typography, and burnt-in styling.
- **Core Technology:** Python, FFmpeg, subtitle layout engines.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rabbanyhmm/VideoCaptionBurner
- **License:** MIT

### 9. Creative Frontend & Motion Engineering
- **Description:** Advanced browser graphics, physics-based canvas animations, and design-forward user interfaces.
- **Key Implementations:** Aerodynamic petal-fall canvas simulation with object pooling and reduced-motion fallbacks; accessible dark glassmorphic color-picker with native EyeDropper API integration.
- **Core Technology:** React, TypeScript, HTML5 Canvas, modern CSS, Web APIs.
